messages:
ana: Heads-up — CometBoard EAP kickoff. Partner sent sample hardware questionnaire this morning, want to confirm logistics + NDA status before we start benchmarking.

samir: I reviewed the doc. Legal says the NDA was countersigned yesterday but we need a tech-export checklist filled out (CometBoard asked about firmware blobs). Tagged @partner-eng to confirm. :white_check_mark:

partner-eng: Confirmed — NDA countersigned by Comet Labs at 2026-03-19 14:02 PT. We asked them to enumerate firmware components; they replied saying one closed BL3 blob for boot. They proposed shipping 3 units next week.

maya: Shipping sounds good. @ops-bot can you create the inbound RMA / lab reservation so we have bench time reserved? Also, who will own the initial smoke tests?

ops-bot: lab-reservation created: LR-2026-CMB-42. ETA CometBoard units -> 2026-03-25. Assigned bench window 2026-03-26 to 2026-03-30. Notification sent to eng-ops.

liam: I can take initial smoke tests and hardware bring-up. Quick ask: do we want to run our usual perf harness or a lighter preliminary heat/kv-cache check first?

ana: (typo, ignore)

samir: Start with a lightweight smoke pass: boot, nvme health, kernel dmesg scan, then run the perf harness on one unit. If that passes, we'll scale to 3 for parallel runs.

liam: Agreed. Drafting a checklist now. Putting it here for visibility:

```
Bring-up checklist - CometBoard EAP
1) Verify NDA in shared vault (legal:doc-id)
2) Image flash (oss-image-2026-02)
3) Boot and network - confirm IP and serial logs
4) nvme SMART, thermal baseline (30m idle)
5) Run smoke perf: ./run_bench --model=gpt-small --seq=512 --iters=20 --batch=1
6) Upload logs to s3://redwood-eap/cometboard/<serial>/
```

maya: Looks good. Add a step to capture pcie topology (lspci -vvv) and GPU driver version. Also tag the runs with `partner=cometboard` and `eap=2026-q1` for telemetry.

partner-eng: We need to confirm what telemetry fields Comet Labs is comfortable sharing. They want metrics aggregated (p95 latency, tokens/sec) but not raw traces. I'll sync on that and push their consent into the NDA annex.

ana: (ignore again)

samir: For benchmarks, propose we run two passes: 1) baseline - stock image + default runtime; 2) tuned - kernel + quantization profile recommended by runtime team. Targets to flag regressions: >=95% of our baseline throughput and p95 within 10% of baseline. Anything outside should open a regression ticket.

liam: I'll include the exact commands and the harness config. Example run command for the perf harness:

```
# lightweight perf run
./redwood_harness --config configs/comet_default.json --model gpt-small --seq 512 --iters 100 --tag "partner=cometboard,eap=2026-q1"
```

samir: Where should logs and perf artifacts go? S3 + a short metadata JSON uploaded to our EAP dashboard would be ideal. Suggest s3://redwood-eap/cometboard/<serial>/artifacts and a dashboard link in the ticket.

partner-eng: Comet asked that we redact any serial numbers in artifacts before we publish dashboards externally. Internal sharing is fine. We'll redact before any partner-facing collateral.

maya: Action items:
- @partner-eng: confirm telemetry consent and export-control note by EOD Friday (4422140000).
- @ops-bot: hold bench window, track inbound shipment (LR-2026-CMB-42).
- @liam: produce the bring-up runbook + harness config and post to the EAP drive.
- @samir: prepare a short kickoff agenda for a 30m sync with Comet (propose Mon 2026-03-23 10am PT).

partner-eng: Will do. Also asked Comet for a spare power supply and the SDK keys for flashing; they said keys will come under an additional MSA — requesting timeline.

samir: Ok — if additional MSA delays flashing, we can still do network and thermals. Plan to do a remote demo for Comet on day 2 of bench window.

liam: One more note — please add `workload=llm-inference` tag in metadata so Optimize can surface cost estimates afterward.

ana: (still a glitch)

maya: Thanks everyone. If partners agree to the timeline, I'll send calendar invites and a concise runbook summary to the Comet contacts. :rocket:
